hook.rumour: Two Elder Council clerks were pulled from Lake Rumare at dawn, each clutching a freshly illuminated pedigree naming a different nobleman as heir to the Ruby Throne.
hook.notice: IMPERIAL WATCH PROCLAMATION: Information regarding the counterfeit Chancery seals circulating in the Market District and around Lake Rumare will be richly rewarded.

stages.objective: Examine the two matching Septim pedigree rolls at the Imperial Watch post in the Imperial City
Track the parchment-maker's watermark north across the lake road to Aleswell
Bring the vellum sample and ink-receipt back to the Chancery archivist in the Imperial City

consequence_detail.summary: Both rival pedigrees were penned on Third Era Chancery vellum stolen from the same sealed archive.

stages.objective: Follow the gold-beater's delivery list from the Imperial City across the northern causeway
Clear the hired cutthroats out of Fort Caractacus and recover the engraved brass signet-dies
Question the courier's factor waiting at Roxey Inn

objectives.text: Follow the gold-beater's delivery list from the Imperial City across the northern causeway

consequence_detail.summary: The signet-dies recovered at Fort Caractacus bear the mark of Caelia Vane, former Chief Herald of the Elder Council.

stages.objective: Ride south from Roxey Inn along the Red Ring Road toward Pell's Gate
Meet the retired sewer-warden in Pell's Gate to learn which sluice-gate leads under the Palace
Seize the Ayleid ring-key from the Council of Ash garrison at Fort Alessia

stages.objective: Carry the Ayleid ring-key from Fort Alessia back to the Imperial City underworks
Descend into the Ring Beneath the Rings and defeat Chief Herald Caelia Vane's bodyguards
Shatter the forgery press and lay the Council of Ash's subscriber roll before the Elder Council
